title: ZenFlow Studio Schedule
features: Weekly grid/list/day schedule with location/instructor/type/time filters, week and date navigation, class details, member and validated guest reservation simulation, waitlist position, cancellation, instructor profile, print and calendar export.
limits: Sample recurring schedule and availability; reservations stay in session memory, no account verification, payment collection, email, automatic waitlist notification or real booking service. Calendar file is a local download.
